results.rationale: Consistency: excluding the added garland, the framing and body scale change substantially, the shirt pattern and sleeves change, facial details are redrawn, and palm/background geometry shifts; most major non-requested details are altered. Instruction: a large loop of flowers has been added around the neck and hangs over the chest, exactly the requested placement. Knowledge: its yellow and magenta blossoms form a multicolored lei, matching the supplied explanation. Quality, edited image alone: coherent face, anatomy, flowers, lighting and fabric; a small malformed white logo/text patch on the hat band is the only conspicuous local imperfection.

Consistency: the left shoe stays in roughly the same position, but its lace arrangement, highlights and toe contour visibly change; the surrounding gray surface also acquires angular tonal boundaries extending beyond the removed shoe. Instruction: the right black shoe is gone, as a one-shoe result requires, but an obvious pale shoe-shaped silhouette remains, making removal incomplete. Quality, edited image alone: the remaining shoe is structurally coherent with readable laces and leather texture, but a large pale silhouette and angular, folded-looking background patch on the right are clear visual flaws.
